# OceanViewFlats

OceanViewFlats offers beachfront short-term rental Properties in Playa Salguero, Santa Marta, Magdalena, Colombia (`https://www.oceanviewflats.com/`). The platform is a fast, multilingual static site with an authoritative Direct Reservation engine settling in Colombian Pesos (`COP`) across 6 languages.

---

## Global Multilingual Support

All public pages are available in 6 languages:

## Direct Reservations, Check-In & Regulatory Compliance

- **Settlement Currency**: All Quotes and Direct Reservations (Credit/Debit Card, PSE bank transfer, or Cash Voucher / Efecty via Mercado Pago) settle in Colombian Pesos (`COP`) with 0% OTA commission, saving 15–20% over third-party OTA fees.
- **Check-in / Check-out**: Check-in begins at `15:00` (3:00 PM) and Check-out is by `11:00` (11:00 AM), with smart-lock self check-in.
- **Cancellation Policy**: 100% refund 14 or more days before Check-in Date; 50% refund (50% Policy Retention) 7–13 days prior; non-refundable within 7 days.
- **Mandatory Guest Registry (`/registry/`)**: Per Colombian hospitality regulations (Law 2068 of 2020 / TRA-SIRE) and Edificio Salguero Sunset security rules, all staying Guests must register identification details (with Law 1581 **Personal Data Authorization** and Law 679 **Minor Guardian Attestation** for Guests under 18) prior to arrival. Submission immediately unlocks the digital **Guest Guide** (`/guide/`), **Assigned Parking Space** clearance, and temporary `0XXXXXX#` smart-lock **Access Credentials**.
- **Building Registration Fee**: Edificio Salguero Sunset condominium administration assesses a mandatory statutory fee of `20,000 COP` per person payable directly at the front-desk reception upon arrival for security wristbands and common areas.
- **Pool Maintenance Schedule**: Building swimming pools at Edificio Salguero Sunset are closed every Tuesday for scheduled maintenance.
- **Data Processing Policy (`/privacy/`)**: Personal data is processed by Data Controller Manuel Enrique Herrera (OceanViewFlats) under Colombian Statutory Law 1581 of 2012 (*Política de Tratamiento de Datos Personales*, Version `2026-10`).

## Location, Playa Salguero Proximity & Santa Marta Landmarks

- **Building & Address**: Edificio Salguero Sunset, Calle 26 # 2-80, Playa Salguero, Santa Marta, Magdalena 470006, Colombia (`11.1876481, -74.2313921`)
- **Playa Salguero Beach**: ~150 m (1 block), ~2 min walk
- **El Rodadero**: ~3 km, ~5–10 min by car
- **Simón Bolívar International Airport (SMR)**: ~10 km, ~15–20 min by car
- **Santa Marta Historic Center (Centro Histórico & Marina)**: ~8 km, ~20–25 min by car
- **Tayrona National Park (El Zaino Entrance)**: ~40 km, ~50–60 min by car
